blocks.title: Gravitational wave
blocks.text: Gravitational wave space ka khinchna aur dabna hai aur do cheezon ke darmiyan lambai ki tabdeeli nap kar dekhi ja sakti hai. Gravitational waves spacetime ke kapre (fabric) mein lehrein hain, jo takrate black holes ya neutron stars jaise shadeed kaainati waqiaat se paida hoti hain, light ki speed se chalti hain aur apne source ki maloomat le jati hain.

Gravitational waves samajhne ki sab se saada misal: agar hum talab mein pathar phenkein to pathar pani ki sath (spacetime) par ripples banata hai. Yeh ripples bahar ki taraf chalti hain aur pathar (kaainati waqiye) ki maloomat le jati hain. Inhein kinare par (gravitational wave observatories se) pakra ja sakta hai, jo pathar ki maujoodgi aur khusoosiyat zahir karti hain.

Gravitational waves Einstein ke general relativity ke nazariye ki peshgoi (prediction) hain jis ki mushahidat ne tasdeeq ki hai aur jo kaainat ke intehai mazahir mein naya dareecha khol rahi hai. Einstein ke general theory of relativity ke mutabiq gravity force nahi balke bhaari ajsaam (massive bodies) se bana spacetime ka kham (curvature) hai. Gravity gadde mein garhe (dent) jaisi hai: bhaari cheezein apne gird space ko mor (warp, print mein 'wrap') deti hain, aur isi liye hum gravity mehsoos karte hain. Albert Einstein (1879-1955), Germany mein paida hone wale nazariyati physicist, duniya ke mashhoor tareen aur muassir tareen scientists mein se hain.

Gravitational waves, jaisa Albert Einstein ne 1916 mein pehli baar peshgoi ki, spacetime mein lehrein hain jo pehli baar 2015 mein pakri gayin. Print us pehle mushahide ko do takrate neutron stars se paida hone wali waves batata hai; isi kitab ka topic 8.7 kehta hai ke 14 September 2015 ko record hone wali waves do black holes ke takrao se aayi thin, jo musallama (accepted) bayan hai. Aise milte nizam mein waves ki frequency aur amplitude mein batadreej izafa hota hai.

blocks.title: Binary system
blocks.text: Gravitational waves ke silsile mein binary system (BS) do compact ajsaam, jaise black holes, neutron stars ya white dwarfs, par mushtamil nizam hai jo ek doosre ke gird ghoomte aur gravitational waves kharij karte hain.
Gravitational waves ki chaar bunyadi aqsam

items: Continuous GWs: jab koi akela bhaari jism mustaqil raftar se ghoome, jaise neutron star, to ek hi frequency aur amplitude wali continuous GWs paida hoti hain. White dwarf binary systems continuous GWs paida karte hain.

Compact binary inspiral GWs (print mein 'inspirational'): tab paida hoti hain jab binary system, jaise binary neutron stars, binary black holes, ya neutron star aur black hole, ek doosre ke gird ghoomein.
Burst GWs: supernovae, gamma-ray bursts ya cosmic strings jaise shadeed waqiaat se paida hoti hain.
Stochastic GWs: kai kamzor gravitational wave sources, jaise door ke binary systems, ki superposition se paida hone wale kamzor, be-tarteeb signals. Inhein pakarna sab se mushkil hai.

blocks.text: Har tez hone wala (accelerate karta) maddi jism gravitational waves paida karta hai, gariyon aur hawai jahazon samet; magar Zameen par ajsaam ke masses aur accelerations itne chhote hain ke hamare aalaat se pakri ja sakne wali bari gravitational waves nahi bana sakte. Dr. Nergis Mavalvala, MIT mein Pakistani-American astrophysicist, gravitational waves par apne kaam ke liye jaani jati hain.

Jab binary systems (jinhein binaries bhi kehte hain) ek doosre ke gird ghoomte hain to gravitational waves kharij karte hain, jo USA mein LIGO (Laser Interferometer Gravitational-wave Observatory) aur Italy ke Cascina mein bari gravitational wave observatory Virgo jaisi observatories pakar sakti hain. Waves nizam ke mass, spin aur milap (merger) ki harkiyat ki maloomat le jati hain, in intehai kaainati ajsaam ki samajh deti hain, aur light ki speed se chalti hain. Binary systems gravitational waves ke aham sources hain, aur un ka milap (do bhaari ajsaam ka takrao aur ittehad jis se ek zyada bhaari jism banta hai) shadeed tareen kaainati waqiaat mein se hai.

Jaise masses ghoomte aur tez hote hain un ki gravitational shiddat badalti hai, aur har simt mein bahar phailti waves banti hain, jaise binary system markaz mein ho aur hum-markaz kurre (spheres) phail rahe hon. Yeh waves binary system ki gravity se bandhi nahi; balke spacetime mein light ki speed se azaadi se chalti hain, aur source se door hote hue un ki shiddat kamzor hoti jati hai. GWs ki khusoosiyat nizam ki khusoosiyat par munhasir hain, jaise ajsaam ke masses, orbital period aur frequency, aur madaar (orbit) ki eccentricity, jo batati hai ke madaar mukammal daire se kitna hatta hai.
Spacetime ka bigaar aur tidal forces

Mass wale jism se guzarti gravitational waves jism ko wafqe wafqe khinchne aur dabne par majboor kar sakti hain, jise spacetime distortion bhi kehte hain. Is asar ko tidal forces kehte hain aur yeh gravitational wave ki jhoolti fitrat ka nateeja hai. Jaise wave jism se guzarti hai, jism ke gird spacetime jhoolta hai, jis se jism wave ke phailao ki simt ke amudi simt mein wafqe wafqe khinchta aur dabta hai. Yeh asar waisa hi hai jaise Zameen par samandar ke madd-o-jazar (tides) Chand aur Suraj ki gravity se hote hain. Khinchne aur dabne ki miqdar wave ki taqat aur jism ke mass aur size par munhasir hai; yeh asar Einstein ke general relativity ki aham peshgoi hai.

Door ke falaki (celestial) waqiaat, jaise do black holes ya neutron stars ke milap, se bani gravitational waves Zameen se guzarti hain. Magar in waves ka amplitude intehai chhota hai, aam taur par 10^-21 se 10^-22 metres ke darje ka, to bigaar bohat hi bareek hai aur pakarne ke liye intehai hassas aalaat chahiye. Chhote amplitude ke bawajood gravitational waves kaainat ka anokha dareecha hain, jo hamein taqatwar gravity parhne, general relativity parakhne, aur kaainat ko pehle na-mumkin tareeqon se dekhne deti hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: phailti gol lehron ke andar ghoomte do compact ajsaam, aur azaad masses ka chhalla jo wave guzarne par baari baari daen baen aur oopar neeche khinchta hai. Oopar daen: peshgoi, gravitational waves ki chaar aqsam aur madaar ki eccentricity. Neeche baen: laser, power recycling mirror, beam splitter, input aur end mirrors wale do arms aur photodetector ke saath Michelson laser interferometer. Neeche daen: ajza, daryaftein aur Examples 8.5 aur 8.6.
blocks.caption: Gravitational waves aur laser interferometer (Figure 8.9 aur topics 8.6 aur 8.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Ek doosre ke gird ghoomte black holes ya neutron stars jaise do compact ajsaam spacetime mein khalal dalte hain, aur yeh khalal gravitational waves ki shakal mein light ki speed se bahar phailta hai. Guzarti wave space ko ek simt mein khinchti aur amudi simt mein dabati hai, phir ulat, to azaad masses ka chhalla baari baari chaura aur lamba ellipse banta hai; Zameen par tabdeeli sirf taqreeban 10^-21 se 10^-22 metres hai. Laser interferometer ise laser beam ko do lambe amudi arms mein taqseem kar ke, beams ko mirrors ke darmiyan takra kar aur dobara mila kar pakarta hai: arms ki lambai badalne se beams ka phase farq aur photodetector par interference pattern badal jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Gravitational waves kya hain, kis ne un ki peshgoi ki, aur tidal forces kaise bante hain (MCQ 8.10, 8.11, 8.13; constructed response 8.6)?
blocks.explanation: Gravitational waves spacetime ke kapre mein lehrein hain, jin ki Albert Einstein ne 1916 mein general relativity se peshgoi ki aur jo zyada tar binary black hole merger jaise tez hote bhaari ajsaam se paida hoti hain. Jab wave kisi jism se guzarti hai to us ke gird spacetime ko jhulati hai, to jism wave ki simt ke amudi wafqe wafqe khinchta aur dabta hai; yeh wafqe wafqe khinchne aur dabne ke asraat tidal forces hain, jaise Chand aur Suraj Zameen par madd-o-jazar paida karte hain.

items: Gravitational waves: shadeed kaainati waqiaat se spacetime mein lehrein, light ki speed se; Einstein ki peshgoi (1916), pehli daryaft 2015. Gravity spacetime ka kham hai (gadde mein garha).

Binary system: do ghoomte, radiate karte compact ajsaam. Aqsam: continuous, compact binary inspiral, burst, stochastic. Masses, orbital period aur frequency, eccentricity par munhasir. Tidal forces: wafqe wafqe khinchna aur dabna; Zameen par amplitude 10^-21 se 10^-22 m.
